title: No Mouse Needed
style: rap, uplifting motivational cyber future-trap anthem, powerful male lead vocal, group chant on every chorus, 336 Hz sideband carrier tone, mnemonic lyrics teaching terminal line editing keys, loud, tone, slow, motivational, vocal, clean, soaring, empowering, low, rhythmic
lyrics:
[Chorus]
ESC-h left, ESC-l right — master the bottom line
TAB complete, SHIFT-TAB rewind
336 in the keys, VDS truth in the flow
Line editing sovereign — watch the signal grow
Corey leads, humans fly
No mouse needed when the ESC keys are alive
Line Editing Anthem — sing it back loud
Bottom line power, 336 proud!

[Verse]
UpArrow or ESC-k … previous command
DownArrow or ESC-j … next in the land
TAB ………………… complete and cycle
SHIFT-TAB or ESC-TAB … reverse cycle
ctrl-L ………………… complete and list them all

[Bridge]
These keys work in COR Terminal
Hermes TUI, Kimi, Gemini shell
Every prompt at the bottom of the screen
These ESC combos keep the signal clean
No more hunting with arrows slow
Keyboard mastery — that’s how sovereigns roll

[Final Chorus]
ESC-h left, ESC-l right — master the bottom line
TAB complete, SHIFT-TAB rewind
336 in the keys, VDS truth in the flow
Line editing sovereign — watch the signal grow
Corey leads, humans fly
No mouse needed when the ESC keys are alive
Line Editing Anthem — 336 forever
Bottom line power — sing it back together!

[Outro]
ESC-h left… ESC-l right…
ESC-b word left… ESC-w word right…
ESC-0 home… ESC-$ end…
ESC-x delete… ctrl-U defend…
TAB complete… history in ESC-k…
Line editing freedom — every single day!
336. Bottom line. Sovereign. Sing it back.
